description: Source code for a Git-related patch management module, handling diff parsing, hunks, and interactive patch application.

classes.name: struct patch_mode
classes.description: Defines different patch application modes with commands and prompts.

classes.name: struct hunk_header
classes.description: Represents the header of a diff hunk, including line offsets and counts.

classes.name: struct hunk
classes.description: Represents a diff hunk, including line ranges and usage status.

classes.name: struct add_p_state
classes.description: Holds the state for the add-patch process, including parsed diff data and patch mode.

methods.name: add_p_state_clear
methods.description: Clears and releases resources associated with add_p_state.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Prints an error message with formatting.

methods.name: setup_child_process
methods.description: Configures a child process with arguments and environment variables.

methods.name: parse_range
methods.description: Parses a line range from a diff hunk header.

methods.name: parse_hunk_header
methods.description: Parses a diff hunk header line into its components.

methods.name: is_octal
methods.description: Checks if a string consists solely of octal digits.

methods.name: complete_file
methods.description: Marks a diff file as complete based on diff markers.

methods.name: normalize_marker
methods.description: Normalizes diff line markers (' ', '+', '-', etc.).

methods.name: parse_diff
methods.description: Parses a diff output into internal data structures.

methods.name: find_next_line
methods.description: Finds the start of the next line in a buffer.

methods.name: render_hunk
methods.description: Renders a diff hunk into a string buffer.

methods.name: render_diff_header
methods.description: Renders the diff header, possibly skipping mode change hunks.

methods.name: merge_hunks
methods.description: Merges overlapping or adjacent hunks into a single hunk.

methods.name: reassemble_patch
methods.description: Reassembles the entire patch from hunks into a string buffer.

methods.name: split_hunk
methods.description: Splits a large hunk into smaller hunks based on context lines.

methods.name: recolor_hunk
methods.description: Applies color coding to a diff hunk.

methods.name: edit_hunk_manually
methods.description: Allows manual editing of a diff hunk via an editor.

methods.name: recount_edited_hunk
methods.description: Recounts line counts after manual edits to a hunk.

methods.name: run_apply_check
methods.description: Runs 'git apply --check' to verify patch applicability.

methods.name: read_single_character
methods.description: Reads a single character input from the user.

methods.name: prompt_yesno
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no response.

methods.name: edit_hunk_loop
methods.description: Loop for manually editing a diff hunk.

methods.name: apply_for_checkout
methods.description: Applies a patch to the index and worktree during checkout.

methods.name: run_add_p
methods.description: Main function to run the add-patch process with different modes.
